answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 47 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh farm has no way to grade its own output. The ridge register is checked at draw time, prism lists the eligible set, and knoll seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 47 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an attacker forfeits for every seat it wants. Honest users pay that once, farms 39 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
